executiveSummary: The 270 distinct scanned forms contain 133 positive, 124 mixed, 11 negative and 1 neutral assessments; one earlier cropped form remains unclear. The latest supplied batch, 5–11 October, adds 34 forms: 19 positive, 14 mixed and 1 neutral. New concerns cover food waiting times, bathroom maintenance, room supplies, menu guidance and the access road. Four new forms explicitly praise service. Food variety (22 forms), service speed (21) and the access road (20) remain recurring concerns. Six earlier forms report pests and two raise room-lock security issues; those checks remain priorities. Figures come from scans only. All 17 new pages were reviewed; 7 ambiguous marks are excluded and one room-improvement comment is partly unclear. One form dated 12 October remains under the supplied batch label. Reporting periods are not verified response dates, and the first entry still has no scans.

insights.title: Check room locks promptly
insights.detail: Two distinct forms in the 31 Aug–6 Sep batch report room-lock problems. One explicitly describes the issue as a security concern. These are guest reports, not verified maintenance findings.
insights.recommendation: Inspect and test affected locks using the private source records, check other guest-room locks, and record repairs and follow-up.

insights.title: Investigate pest reports
insights.detail: Six distinct forms across three reporting periods report pests. The 14–20 September batch includes three cockroach reports involving rooms, with two also mentioning the restaurant. These are guest reports requiring verification; favourable ratings elsewhere do not cancel them.
insights.recommendation: Inspect the reported spaces, review pest-control and cleaning records, address entry points and verify follow-up results.

insights.title: Broaden food choice and keep options available
insights.detail: Food variety is flagged on 22 forms; availability on 6. The latest batch includes a request for alternative tea products and a lowest food-choice rating. Earlier requests include buffet and drink choices, later menu availability and breakfast supplies. Counts overlap.
insights.recommendation: Review buffet rotation and stock planning; communicate unavailable dishes before orders, and assess a limited late-evening menu.

insights.title: Improve speed and keep guests informed
insights.detail: Service speed is flagged on 21 forms. Two forms in the 5–11 October batch report food delays while also praising food or freshness. Earlier comments include food delays and requests for food-ready calls; favourable and adverse evidence are retained.
insights.recommendation: Track order-to-service time, agree who notifies guests when orders are ready, and review breakfast readiness and table clearing.

insights.title: Repair missing or nonworking room essentials
insights.detail: Amenities are flagged on 18 forms and room maintenance on 17, with overlap. The latest batch reports a leaking toilet, discoloured bathroom sealant and a poorly functioning television, and requests room bins and a mirror. Earlier reports include hot-water, drainage and air-conditioner problems.
insights.recommendation: Use a room-readiness checklist for amenities, television, hot water, shower and leaks. Track reported faults through resolution.

insights.title: Improve the arrival experience
insights.detail: The access road is flagged on 20 forms, and wayfinding on 5. Two forms in the 5–11 October batch request road improvements; another praises ease of locating the property. Categories overlap.
insights.recommendation: Assess road repairs with the responsible parties and add clear approach signs and arrival directions.

insights.title: Review food quality and portions
insights.detail: Food temperature is flagged on 5 forms, freshness on 10, portions on 12 and flavour on 10. The latest batch adds one lowest freshness rating. Earlier reports cover freshness, hard beef, insufficiently crisp yam and small portions. These are guest reports and selected ratings, not confirmed food-safety findings; counts overlap.
insights.recommendation: Review food holding and service routines, investigate freshness reports and standardize portions against what guests are offered.

insights.title: Preserve the hospitality guests value
insights.detail: Explicit praise includes service on 43 forms, staff friendliness on 11 and professionalism on 4. Categories overlap; positive ticks alone do not count as written praise.
insights.recommendation: Recognize the behaviours guests praise and use them in coaching, alongside the specific service concerns.

insights.title: Keep the setting and enjoyable stays central
insights.detail: Explicit comments praise the overall experience on 74 forms and ambience on 13. Some of the same forms also request improvements.
insights.recommendation: Preserve the welcoming setting while addressing the concrete concerns listed in mixed feedback.

insights.title: Check food freshness and preparation
insights.detail: In the 21–27 September reporting period: two forms flag freshness: one reports fish that was not fresh, and another gives freshness the lowest rating alongside flavour, presentation and choice. A third form reports hard rice despite favourable food ratings. These reports require verification.
insights.recommendation: Check ingredient freshness, storage and preparation, and review the reported dishes and rice texture before service.

insights.title: Reduce food delays and review portions
insights.detail: In the 21–27 September reporting period: two forms report food delays and two report small portions, with one form in both groups. Good food marks coexist with portion complaints.
insights.recommendation: Track order waiting times, communicate delays and check portion standards against the menu.

insights.title: Follow up late housekeeping and dish collection
insights.detail: In the 21–27 September reporting period: one form reports cleaning delayed until evening and breakfast dishes left in the room all day, alongside poor room service. Good room ratings do not cancel the written complaint.
insights.recommendation: Review housekeeping completion times and room-service collection rounds, and follow up the complaint using private records.

insights.title: Check beachfront internet and recreation provision
insights.detail: In the 21–27 September reporting period: one form reports no beachfront internet; a separate form reports no gym. These are guest reports about availability.
insights.recommendation: Test internet coverage in beachfront guest areas and clarify available fitness facilities and alternatives.

insights.title: Verify food freshness and preparation
insights.detail: In the 28 September–4 October supplied batch: Two forms give freshness and flavour the lowest rating. One reports tilapia believed to be from the previous day and poorly prepared; another reports hard beef and fried yam lacking crispness. These are guest reports requiring verification.
insights.recommendation: Review ingredient storage, preparation and holding practices, and check texture and freshness before serving.

insights.title: Check room maintenance and readiness
insights.detail: In the 28 September–4 October supplied batch: Four forms flag room maintenance. Reports cover an air-conditioner leak, hot-water systems, general upkeep and a window blind; two of these forms also request television channels or room items prepared before occupancy.
insights.recommendation: Inspect the reported systems and add hot-water, air-conditioner, blind and room-readiness checks before occupancy.

insights.title: Reduce food waiting times
insights.detail: In the 5–11 October supplied batch: Two forms report long food waits, while praising the food or its freshness. Several other forms give service speed an average rating without a written delay complaint.
insights.recommendation: Track order-to-table times, coordinate kitchen and service staff, and explain expected waits.

insights.title: Inspect bathroom maintenance and room supplies
insights.detail: In the 5–11 October supplied batch: Two forms report bathroom maintenance issues: a leaking toilet and discoloured sealant. Requests also cover additional towels, room bins and a mirror; another form reports a poorly functioning television.
insights.recommendation: Inspect the toilet and sealant, check televisions, and review towel, bin and mirror provision before rooms are released.

insights.title: Review food choices, freshness and menu guidance
insights.detail: In the 5–11 October supplied batch: Two forms flag food choice, including a request for alternative tea products and one lowest choice rating. The latter also gives freshness the lowest rating. Three forms mark menu explanation needs improvement. Counts overlap.
insights.recommendation: Review beverage choices, check freshness controls and coach staff to explain menu options clearly.
